pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown regions exhibit complex, non-geometric polygonal geometry with high-frequency serrated edge gradients. Patch spatial area is large on the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more elongated shapes on the upper neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored negative space forms a continuous network of narrow pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-coordinate. Pixel thickness is consistent across the shoulder and neck, maintaining a high contrast ratio with the patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane presents a distinct dark linear silhouette along the dorsal neck with low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged edges against the sky/background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark-toned avian organism (oxpecker) clinging to the anterior-lateral aspect of the lower neck/chest junction.
